disabled.description: Prevents selection by every modality and exposes the unavailable state.

selected.description:
Output-only selected state written by `ki-tabs`. Set the group's `value`
to choose an initial tab; author-set `selected` is overwritten.

value.description:
Pairing identifier shared with a `ki-tab-panel`. The first tab with a
value owns it; later duplicates render but are not selectable.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-motion-distance-xs.description: Motion travel distance xs (2px): hover-lift offsets.

--ki-tab-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for a tab surface.

--ki-tab-bg-image.description: Optional surface image for a tab.

--ki-tab-focus-ring-color.description: color used by the tab component for focus ring color.

--ki-tab-focus-ring-offset.description: dimension used by the tab component for focus ring offset.

--ki-tab-focus-ring-shadow.description: shadow used by the tab component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).

--ki-tab-focus-ring-width.description: dimension used by the tab component for focus ring width.

--ki-tab-font-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for font size.

--ki-tab-font-weight.description: font weight used by the tab component for font weight.

--ki-tab-gap.description: dimension used by the tab component for gap.

--ki-tab-icon-inline-gap.description: Gap from an inline tab icon to its label.

--ki-tab-icon-size.description: Inline and block size of a decorative tab icon.

--ki-tab-indicator-color.description: color used by the tab component for indicator color (MarsUI active underline is Outline/inverse_white: black in light, white in dark — the inverse neutral, not primary).

--ki-tab-indicator-radius.description: dimension used by the tab component for indicator radius (the master underline is a square-ended 2px bottom border).

--ki-tab-indicator-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for indicator size.

--ki-tab-line-height.description: dimension used by the tab component for line height.

--ki-tab-min-block-size.description: dimension used by the tab component for min block size (MarsUI Tab_nav md bar height 40px: 24px body_1 label + 8px block-end clearance + underline; retargeted from ki.space.7xl per the fidelity audit — material3 pins its own value).

--ki-tab-padding-block-end.description: dimension used by the tab component for padding block end (MarsUI Tab_nav_item: 8px inset keeping the 2px underline clear of the 13/24 label; formalizes the fallback ki-tab.css already consumes).

--ki-tab-padding-inline.description: dimension used by the tab component for padding inline (MarsUI items carry no inline padding: spacing comes from the bar gap and the underline spans the full item width).

--ki-tab-radius.description: dimension used by the tab component for radius.

--ki-tab-selected-active-bg.description: color used by the tab component for selected active background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).

--ki-tab-selected-active-fg.description: color used by the tab component for selected active foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never the accent; master 10048:1240).

--ki-tab-selected-disabled-bg.description: color used by the tab component for selected disabled background (no disabled variant exists in Tab_nav; disabled must be quieter than rest, not a filled pill).

--ki-tab-selected-disabled-fg.description: color used by the tab component for selected disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder: Gray/500 light / White-32 dark, the value ki-status and ki-switch already use for disabled glyphs).

--ki-tab-selected-hover-bg.description: color used by the tab component for selected hover background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).

--ki-tab-selected-hover-fg.description: color used by the tab component for selected hover foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never the accent; master 10048:1240).

--ki-tab-selected-rest-bg.description: color used by the tab component for selected rest background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).

--ki-tab-selected-rest-fg.description: color used by the tab component for selected rest foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never the accent; master 10048:1240).

--ki-tab-unselected-active-bg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected active background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).

--ki-tab-unselected-active-fg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected active foreground (mirrors hover; MarsUI defines no pressed variant).

--ki-tab-unselected-disabled-bg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected disabled background (no disabled variant exists in Tab_nav; disabled must be quieter than rest, not a filled pill).

--ki-tab-unselected-disabled-fg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder: Gray/500 light / White-32 dark, the value ki-status and ki-switch already use for disabled glyphs).

--ki-tab-unselected-hover-bg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected hover background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).

--ki-tab-unselected-hover-fg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected hover foreground (with rest at med_em, hover darkens one em step, preserving the master rest-to-hover direction).

--ki-tab-unselected-rest-bg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected rest background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).

--ki-tab-unselected-rest-fg.description: color used by the tab component for unselected rest foreground (Figma inactive is Text/low_em, which fails the 4.5:1 text gate at 13px; med_em is the gate-compliant rest value — declared deviation).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

slots.description: Required visible text label and accessible name source.

end.description: Trailing icon or media. Follows writing direction.

icon.description: Decorative SVG. Supply visible text in the default slot.

start.description: Leading icon or media. Follows writing direction.
